source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper states that its high-frequency recovery theorem assumes non-Gaussian innovations; under its additional full-rank, nonzero-diagonal, weak-connectivity conditions, it gives A'=A for odd k and A'=A or -A for even k.
The article presents identification and estimation for subsampled and mixed-frequency SVARs when shocks are non-Gaussian, including an EM inference method.
The paper derives asymptotic distributions, Wald-type confidence procedures, and an efficiency result for frequency-domain causal-effect estimators under identified fine-grid SVAR structure.
